Hub.title: Nodle
Hub.description: The daily node deduction game for Technical Artists.
Hub.subtitle: Choose your challenge. Compete in daily challenges with other artists or practice at your own pace.
Hub.play_classic_desc: The original mode. One random node per day from the entire pool. Compete on the global Leaderboard.
Hub.practice_desc: Play with no time limits. Configure the difficulty and software to train at your own pace.
Hub.tier1_desc: Only highly frequent nodes (e.g. Math, Multiply, Texture Coordinate). Perfect for beginners.
Hub.tier2_desc: Intermediate nodes and specific math operations (e.g. Map Range, Dot Product).
Hub.tier3_desc: The procedural abyss. Only the most obscure and rarely used nodes.
Hub.blender_desc: An exclusive daily node from the Blender ecosystem (Shader and Geometry Nodes).
Hub.unreal_desc: A daily node from the UE5 Blueprints or Material Expressions system.
Hub.unity_desc: Daily challenge focused on Unity Shader Graph and Visual Scripting.
Hub.houdini_desc: Daily challenge focused on Houdini VOPs/SOPs.
Hub.substance_desc: Daily challenge focused on Substance Designer nodes.
Hub.support_desc_1: Nodle is a passion project created for the tech art community, with no invasive ads or paywalls. However, server costs, real-time databases for the Leaderboard, and hosting grow with every new player.
Hub.support_desc_2: If you enjoy the game, please consider buying us a coffee. Every bit of help is immensely appreciated and allows us to keep creating more challenges!
Hub.footer_created: Created with ♥ for the Technical Artists community.
Hub.footer_legal: Nodle is an unofficial fan project. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Epic Games, Unity Technologies, Blender Foundation, SideFX, or Adobe. All trademarks belong to their respective owners.

Game.practice_desc: Practice endlessly. Results do not affect your streak or daily Leaderboard.
Game.unsupported_clipboard: Your browser does not support copying images to the clipboard directly. Use a phone or a modern browser!
Game.no_nodes_filters: No nodes found with these filters. Try a different combination.
